[Fake transcript for testing. No real client. Listing appointment, 412 Royal St, Zachary, LA. Oct 14, 2026.]

Caleb: Thanks for having me out, Taylor. Before I get into anything, tell me what's going on. Why are y'all thinking about selling?

Taylor: So my husband got transferred to Houston. It starts in January. We'd love to be settled there before the kids start the spring semester, so realistically we need to be under contract by early December.

Caleb: Got it. So the timeline is the thing. Let's talk about the house. Y'all bought it in 2019, right?

Taylor: 2019, yeah. We put a new roof on in 2023 after the storm, and we redid the kitchen two years ago. The back fence needs work, honestly, and the master bath is original.

Caleb: That's fine, the kitchen and roof are what buyers in Copper Mill ask about first. Any concerns on your end about the process?

Taylor: Two things. We don't want a bunch of strangers through the house while the kids are home, and we're worried about pricing it wrong and sitting there while we're paying for two places.

Caleb: Both fair. On showings we can set windows, and I use ShowingTime so you approve every one. On price, I pulled the three closest sales. The one on Turnberry closed at $352,000 in August, the one two streets over went for $341,000 in July, and the bigger one on Copper Mill Boulevard hit $368,000 but it has the extra bedroom. Your kitchen is nicer than two of those. I'd put you at $345,000 to $359,000, and I'd lean toward listing at $349,900 to draw the most showings in the first ten days.

Taylor: We were hoping for closer to three sixty.

Caleb: I hear you. If we list at three sixty we lose the first-weekend crowd, and with your December deadline that first weekend matters more than the extra ten. We can always counter up. What I'd rather do is price at $349,900, open house the first Saturday, and let the buyers push.

Taylor: Okay. That makes sense with the deadline.

Caleb: On the agreement side, I work on a six-month listing term, though we're planning on being done way before that, and my side is 2.5 percent. I'll talk through buyer agent compensation when we get offers.

Taylor: Fine. What happens next?

Caleb: If you're good with this, I'll send you a one-page summary of what we talked about today. You accept that, I send the listing agreement through Authentisign, and I get the photographer out next Tuesday. We'd be live on the MLS the Thursday after, October 23, and open house Saturday the 25th.

Taylor: Let's do it. Honestly we just want this part over so we can focus on the move.

Caleb: Understood. I'll have that to you tonight.
